DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かございましたか。散歩道のほうから来られましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened? You came from the walking path, didn't you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池の手前で、大きな枝が道をふさいでいます。通ろうとして引き返しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池の手前の枝で道がふさがれ引き返したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A large branch is blocking the path before the pond. I was going to pass through but turned back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a branch before the pond blocked the path and you turned back. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知らせてくださってありがとうございます。案内図で場所を指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. Could you point out the location on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この曲がり角です。ベンチのすぐ先で、まだ木につながっているように見えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内図の曲がり角とベンチ先を示し枝が木につながる様子を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this bend. Just past the bench, and it looked as though the branch was still attached to the tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the bend on the map and the spot past the bench, and describe how the branch appeared attached to the tree. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 近づいたり引っ張ったりせず、そのままにしてください。私から担当に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave it alone without approaching or pulling it. I'll contact the staff responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 枝には触っていません。ほかの人も来ていたので、職員に知らせるとだけ伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枝に触れず他の人へ職員に知らせると伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't touched the branch. Other people were coming too, so I only told them I would notify the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not touch the branch and only told others you would inform the staff. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。私たちが状況を確認しますので、ご自身で通行を誘導しなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We'll check the situation, so you don't need to direct people yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 池へ行くのはやめて、入口へ戻ります。この広い道なら通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池へ行かず入口へ戻る広い道の通行状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give up going to the pond and return to the entrance. Can I use this wide path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the wide path back to the entrance is passable, saying you will not go to the pond. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここから入口へ戻る道には、今のところそのような報告はありません。周囲を見ながらお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: So far, we haven't had any reports like that about the path from here back to the entrance. Please watch your surroundings as you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広い道で戻ります。途中にまた枝が落ちていたら近づかずに知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広い道で戻り別の落枝にも近づかず報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go back along the wide path. If there is another fallen branch on the way, I'll report it without going near it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return along the wide path and report any other fallen branch without approaching it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご報告に感謝します。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reporting it. Please take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その列車は現在遅れています。ご予定に影響がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That train is currently delayed. Does it affect your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工場見学の受付が十一時までです。今の遅れだと間に合うか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工場見学の受付時刻と遅延による不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Check-in for my factory tour closes at eleven. With the current delay, I can't tell whether I'll make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the factory tour check-in deadline and your concern about the delay. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運転再開の時刻はまだ発表されていません。目的地はどちらの駅ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The time services will resume has not been announced yet. Which station is your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 海田駅です。受付には、何時に着くと連絡すればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地を示し連絡すべき到着時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaita Station. What arrival time should I tell the reception staff?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your destination and ask what arrival time to report. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現時点では到着時刻を確約できません。遅延していて見込みが未定だと伝えるのがよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot guarantee an arrival time at this point. It would be best to say that the train is delayed and the expected arrival is undetermined.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 未定のまま連絡します。別の交通手段の所要時間も比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着未定と連絡し代替交通の時間比較を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact them saying the time is still undetermined. I'd also like to compare how long other transport would take.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will report an undetermined arrival time and want to compare travel times for alternative transport. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅前の交通案内でバスの時刻を確認できますが、接続次第で時間が変わります。こちらの切符で乗れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check bus times at the transport information point in front of the station, but the time needed depends on connections. You may not be able to use this ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加の運賃がかかる可能性も含めて調べます。切符の払い戻しは、買った窓口で相談すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加運賃も考慮し切符の払い戻し相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check, including the possibility of an extra fare. For a ticket refund, should I consult the counter where I bought it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take additional fares into account and ask where to inquire about a ticket refund. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入場所だけでなく切符の種類も確認が必要です。この切符を担当窓口で見てもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need to check not only where it was purchased but also the ticket type. Let's have the appropriate counter look at this ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先方から受付を待つと返事がありました。切符の条件を確認してから、この列車を待つことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先方の返事を報告し切符確認後に列車を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: They've replied that they will wait for me to check in. I'll check the ticket conditions and then wait for this train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report their reply and decide to wait for the train after checking the ticket. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、放送と表示の更新をご確認ください。見学へ向かわれる際はお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please watch for updated announcements and displays. Take care on your way to the tour.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知について、相談の予約をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to book a consultation about the notice you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知の説明を一人では理解しにくいので、通訳が必要なことも予約時に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知を理解するため通訳が必要だと予約時に伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The explanation in the notice is difficult to understand on my own, so I'd also like to tell them when booking that I need an interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to mention at the time of booking that you need an interpreter to understand the notice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当部署に対応を確認します。どの言語の支援をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the department responsible about support. Which language would you like assistance in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語を希望します。日本語の短い質問には答えられますが、手続きの説明は難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望言語と理解できる日本語の範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese, please. I can answer short questions in Japanese, but explanations of procedures are difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your preferred language and how much Japanese you can understand. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な支援の程度も伝えますね。通知の差出部署を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll also tell them how much support you need. Can we check which department sent the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 差出部署はこの欄でしょうか。封筒だけでなく、中の通知も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出部署の欄を尋ね通知本体も提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is this the section for the sending department? I brought the notice inside as well as the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which section identifies the sending department and show the notice itself too. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この部署です。予約の空きと通訳の対応は別々に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it's this department. Appointment availability and interpreter support must be checked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 月曜の午後なら休みを取れます。通訳の手配ができるとわかってから、日時を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望曜日を示し通訳対応確認後に日時を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can take time off on Monday afternoon. I'd like to decide the date and time after we know an interpreter can be arranged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your preferred day and say you want to choose the date and time after interpreter availability is confirmed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ希望を伝え、折り返す方法を確認しましょう。連絡が取れる時間帯はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's pass on your wishes to the department and check how they can get back to you. Is there a time when you can be reached?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼休みの十二時から一時なら電話に出られます。支援と日時の両方が決まったか聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話に出られる時間帯と支援日時の再確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can answer the phone during my lunch break, from twelve to one. I'll ask again whether both the support and the appointment time are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State when you can answer the phone and that you will reconfirm both support and appointment time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その時間帯を伝えます。通知は予約の日まで保管してください、本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell them that time window. Please keep the notice until your appointment day. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察が終わりましたね。何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your consultation is finished. Is there anything you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場から「受診した証明」を出すよう言われました。どの書類のことかわからず困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場から求められた受診証明の書類名が不明だと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace told me to submit “proof that I saw a doctor.” I'm unsure which document that means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because you do not know the name of the document your workplace wants as proof of a medical visit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書などでよいか、診断書が必要かを職場に確認できますか。書類の申込みは担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check with your workplace whether a receipt or similar document is enough, or a medical certificate is needed? I'll direct you to the appropriate counter for document applications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職場に聞くとき、領収書と診断書では何が違うと説明すればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書と診断書の違いを職場へ説明するため尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I ask my workplace, how should I explain the difference between a receipt and a medical certificate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between a receipt and a medical certificate so you can explain it to your workplace. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 領収書は支払いの記録で、診断書は医師が診断内容などを記す書類です。必要な内容は職場に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: A receipt records payment, while a medical certificate is a document in which the doctor writes the diagnosis and related details. Please ask your workplace what information they require.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受診日だけが必要なのか、診断内容も必要なのかを先に聞きます。いま電話しても構いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場に必要な内容を確認すると述べ通話可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll first ask whether they only need the visit date or also the diagnosis. May I make a phone call now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check what information your workplace needs and ask whether you can make a call. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通話できる場所をご案内します。こちらの廊下ではお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you where you can make calls. Please refrain from calling in this corridor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通話場所で確認したら、受診日がわかる領収書でよいそうです。診断書の申込みはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書でよいという回答を報告し診断書は申し込まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked from the calling area, and they say a receipt showing the visit date is enough. I won't apply for a medical certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that a receipt is sufficient and say you will not request a medical certificate. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では領収書の内容を会計窓口でご確認ください。診療について気になることは残っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please check the receipt details at the payment counter. Do you still have any concerns about your medical care?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は書類の疑問だけでした。会計で受診日の記載を確かめ、原本を保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計で受診日の記載を確認し原本を保管すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I only had questions about the paperwork. I'll check the visit date is shown at the payment counter and keep the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the visit date on the receipt at the payment counter and keep the original. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わかりました。お気をつけてお帰りください、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take care on your way home, and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布の紛失についてですね。なくなったと気づいたのはどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your lost wallet. Where did you realize it was missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バスから降りて飲み物を買おうとしたら、鞄に財布がありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バスを降りた後に財布の紛失へ気づいた状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: After getting off the bus, I tried to buy a drink and found my wallet wasn't in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe how you noticed your wallet was missing after getting off the bus. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所と、その後の移動を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me where you last used it and where you went afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時十分に薬局で払ってから、駅前のバスに乗りました。降りたのは東団地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の支払い時刻と乗降場所を順番に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I paid at the pharmacy at two ten, then boarded the bus in front of the station. I got off at Higashi Danchi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in order your last payment time and where you boarded and got off. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 財布の特徴と中身も伺います。ほかの物と区別できる傷などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll also ask about the wallet's appearance and contents. Does it have any scratches or other marks that distinguish it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 茶色の長財布で、留め具の横に白い擦り傷があります。銀行カードも一枚入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布の擦り傷と銀行カードの同封を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a brown long wallet with a white scuff beside the clasp. There is also one bank card inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the scuff on the wallet and the bank card inside. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を記録します。銀行にはカードの停止について早めに連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record those features. Please contact your bank promptly about blocking the card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行への連絡先を確かめます。バス会社にも、乗った時刻と降りた停留所を伝えて探してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行へ連絡しバス会社にも移動情報で問い合わせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check how to contact the bank. I'd also like to tell the bus company when I boarded and the stop where I got off so they can look for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the bank and also inquire with the bus company using your journey details. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報が問い合わせの手がかりになります。届け出には連絡が取れる番号も記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That information will provide clues for your inquiry. Please also enter a number where you can be reached on the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯番号を書きました。財布が見つかったら、どの連絡を受けて受け取りに来ればよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入し発見後の連絡と受け取りを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my mobile number. If the wallet is found, I'd like to confirm what contact I should receive before coming to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have entered your mobile number and want to check the contact and collection process if it is found. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかった際の連絡と受け取り方法をご説明します。お帰りの道中もお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain how we will contact you and how to collect it if found. Please take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。荷物のお受け取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Are you here to collect a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の近くの窓口なら受け取れると思って来ましたが、この票に別の場所が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近くの窓口で受け取れると思い保管場所を読み違えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could collect it at the counter near my home, so I came, but this notice gives a different location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought you could collect it at the nearby counter and misread the storage location. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物の保管場所はこの欄で確認します。こちらとは異なる窓口になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The parcel's storage location is shown in this section. It is a different counter from this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここには荷物がないということですね。今日このまま保管先へ行く前に、受付時間を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物が別窓口にあると確認し訪問前の受付時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the parcel isn't here. Before going straight to the storage location today, I'd like to know its opening hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the parcel is at a different counter and ask its opening hours before visiting. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の種類と窓口の受付時間を確認します。票に記載された問い合わせ先へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the parcel type and counter opening hours. Can you contact the inquiry number on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で電話します。番号だけでなく、保管期限も伝えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で問い合わせると述べ番号と期限の伝え方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call myself. Should I tell them the storage deadline as well as the number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will inquire yourself and check how to give the number and deadline. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物の番号を伝え、希望の受け取り日時が期限内かも確認してください。必要な持ち物は保管先へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Give them the parcel number and also check whether your desired collection date and time are within the deadline. Ask the storage location what you need to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話したら、今日の夕方に受け取れると言われました。不在票と本人確認書類を持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話で確認した受取時刻と必要な持ち物を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I called and was told I could collect it this evening. I'll bring the notice and identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the collection time and required items confirmed by phone. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内された窓口の所在地も確認できましたか。似た名前の窓口がありますのでご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you also confirmed the address of the counter they directed you to? Be careful, as there is another counter with a similar name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所をメモしました。最初に保管場所を読み違えたので、今度は住所と受付時間を照合して向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管先の住所と受付時間を照合して向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the address. Since I misread the storage location at first, this time I'll cross-check the address and opening hours before going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will cross-check the storage location's address and opening hours before going. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お受け取り先が確認できてよかったです。どうぞお気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you could confirm where to collect it. Please take care on your way there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: キャッシュカードが見当たらないとのことですね。どこで気づかれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can't find your cash card, correct? Where did you notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅して財布を開いたら、銀行のカードだけありませんでした。先に利用を止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時に銀行カードだけがなく先に停止したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I got home and opened my wallet, only the bank card was missing. I'd like to block it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that only your bank card was missing when you got home and you want to block it first. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人確認を進めます。カード番号以外に、口座を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll proceed with identification. Apart from the card number, do you have anything that can identify your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通帳と在留カードを持ってきました。暗証番号はここでは口に出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳と本人確認書類を示し暗証番号を口頭で言わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've brought my passbook and residence card. I'll make sure not to say my PIN aloud here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your passbook and identification and say you will not give your PIN aloud. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者が確認して停止のお手続きを進めます。再発行についても相談しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The staff member responsible will check and proceed with blocking it. Would you also like to discuss a replacement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再発行は、手数料と受け取るまでの間に現金を引き出せるかを聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再発行の費用と待つ間の引き出し方法を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to decide about a replacement after asking about the fee and whether I can withdraw cash while waiting to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the replacement cost and how to withdraw cash while waiting. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件や利用できる手続きは担当者に確認します。まず停止を優先してよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the conditions and available procedures with the staff member responsible. May we prioritize blocking it first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、停止を先にお願いします。あとで家からカードが出てきた場合も、そのまま使わないほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止を優先し発見後にそのまま使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please block it first. If the card turns up at home later, should I avoid using it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize blocking and ask whether you can simply use it if found. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 停止後に見つかっても、ご自分の判断で使わず当行へご相談ください。必要な扱いを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you find it after it is blocked, don't use it at your own discretion; consult our bank. We'll check and explain how it needs to be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかっても使う前に連絡します。停止が完了したかを確認してから、再発行の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見後は連絡し停止完了確認後に再発行説明を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact you before using it even if I find it. I'll confirm blocking is complete before hearing about a replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the bank if found and hear about replacement after confirming blocking is complete. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へその順番で引き継ぎます。本日はご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that sequence on to the staff member responsible. Thank you for visiting today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの乾麺の包装について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the packaging of these dried noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った袋に小さな穴がありました。まだ開けていませんし、麺も食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乾麺の袋の穴と未開封未食用の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a small hole in the bag I bought yesterday. I haven't opened it or eaten any noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the hole in the dried noodle bag and say it is unopened and uneaten. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 穴の位置を確認します。購入後はどこに置いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check where the hole is. Where did you keep it after purchasing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台所の棚に置きました。買ったときからあったのかはわからないので、そのまま袋ごと持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保管場所と破損時期が不明なことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: On a kitchen shelf. I don't know whether the hole was there when I bought it, so I brought the whole bag as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you stored it and that you do not know when the damage happened. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レシートもお持ちでしょうか。購入情報と状態を責任者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you also have the receipt? I'll ask the person in charge to check the purchase information and condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートはこれです。同じ商品が必要ですが、交換の対象になるか先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートを示し交換可否の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the receipt. I need the same product, but please first check whether it is eligible for exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and ask them to check whether it can be exchanged. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 責任者が状態を確認したところ、今回は交換で対応できるとのことです。新しい袋を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge has checked the condition and says we can exchange it this time. Let's inspect the new bag together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの袋には穴が見当たりません。古いほうは店に預けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい袋に穴がないことを確認し古い袋を預けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't see any holes in this bag. Can I leave the old one with the store?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the new bag has no holes and ask whether you can hand over the old bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらでお預かりします。交換した商品には、この控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll keep it here. Here is a slip for the exchanged product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい袋と控えを受け取りました。帰宅してからも、調理前に袋の状態を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品と控えを受け取り調理前にも包装を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the new bag and the slip. I'll check the bag's condition again before cooking, even after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have received the product and slip and will check the packaging before cooking too. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不便をおかけしました。商品を忘れずに、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sorry for the inconvenience. Don't forget your product, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの案内図では、何をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you looking for on the map you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前撮った写真にあるあずまやで休みたいのですが、この場所に見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古い案内図にあるあずまやが見つからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to rest at the gazebo in a photo I took before, but I can't find it at this location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot find the gazebo shown on the old map. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真は古い案内図ですね。あずまやは現在、管理棟の北側に移っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That photo is of an old map. The gazebo has now been moved to the north side of the management building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い場所へ進んでいました。今いる花壇から、北側へ行く道を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在地の花壇から移設先までの道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was heading toward the old location. Could you tell me how to get to the north side from the flower bed where I am now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for directions from the flower bed where you are to the new location. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇の右手を進むと管理棟があります。その建物の裏側へ回る道が、あずまやへ続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Go to the right of the flower bed and you'll reach the management building. The path around to the back of that building leads to the gazebo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏側まで行く途中に階段はありますか。今日は足に負担の少ない道を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 足への負担を避けるため途中の階段を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Are there stairs on the way to the back? Today I'd like a route that is easier on my legs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether there are stairs on the way so you can avoid strain on your legs. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 建物の東側なら階段を避けられます。西側には段差がありますので、東側へ回ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can avoid stairs on the east side of the building. The west side has steps, so please go around the east side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 東側を通ります。休んだあとは、今入ってきた花壇前の入口へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 東側を通り入園した花壇前の入口へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go along the east side. After resting, I'd like to return to the entrance in front of the flower bed where I just came in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will go along the east side and want to return to the entrance in front of the flower bed where you entered. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: あずまやから管理棟の東側を通り、同じ花壇へ戻れます。新しい案内図にも入口を印しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: From the gazebo, you can pass along the east side of the management building and return to the same flower bed. I'll mark the entrance on the new map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい図であずまやと入口を確認できました。写真も撮り直して、同じ道で帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい図の位置を確認し写真を撮り直して同じ道で戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've located the gazebo and entrance on the new map. I'll take a new photo too and return by the same route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the locations on the new map, and say you will take a new photo and return the same way. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい案内図をご活用ください。休憩しながら、どうぞよいお散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of the new map. Enjoy your walk, taking breaks along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いの前に、画面の行き先を確かめていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the destination on the screen before paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた駅名と比べると、今選んだ駅は最後の一文字が違うようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入画面の駅名の最後の文字が友人の指定と違うと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Compared with the station name my friend sent, it looks like the last character of the station I selected is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that the last character of the station name on the purchase screen differs from your friend's specified station. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ支払い前ですね。選択を戻して、駅名をもう一度お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't paid yet. Go back from this selection and check the station name again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメッセージにある駅へ行きたいので、検索欄に名前を入れ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人のメッセージの駅名を検索欄へ入れ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to go to the station in this message, so I'd like to enter its name again in the search field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to reenter the station name from your friend's message in the search field. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検索欄へ戻りました。同じ名前の一部を含む駅があるため、全体を見て選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We're back at the search field. Some stations share part of the same name, so look at the whole name when selecting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今度は文字が全部一致していますが、枚数が二枚になっているので、一枚へ直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅名は一致したが二枚になった切符の枚数を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This time all the characters match, but the quantity is two tickets. Can I change it to one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the quantity set to two tickets while confirming the station name now matches. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 枚数の欄で一枚を選んでください。次に、片道か往復かもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Select one in the quantity field. Next, also check whether it is one-way or round-trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは友人の車に乗る予定なので、片道を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りは友人の車に乗るため片道を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm planning to return in my friend's car, so I'll choose one-way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one-way because you will return in your friend's car. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行き先と枚数と片道の選択がそろいました。合計額を見てからお支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The destination, quantity, and one-way option are all set. Check the total before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名をもう一度メッセージと比べ、一枚の片道券になっていることを確かめて買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メッセージと駅名を照合し一枚の片道券を確認して購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll compare the station name with the message once more and confirm it's one one-way ticket before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the station name with the message, confirm one one-way ticket, and buy it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 購入後も切符の表示をお確かめください。どうぞ、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the information printed on the ticket after purchasing too. Have a good trip.
